outcome.technical: Checked every sentence the finding quotes against HEAD 57fd38c4 before editing. Commit 9eeea6d5 (P142.14) had already rewritten all but one of them. `grep -n -i 'stage_grant\|SWEEP_STAGE_GRANT\|grant\|block pool\|run_order\|times the slots' CLAUDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/sweep-selftests.py` was the grep run. (1) CLAUDE.md: no `stage_grant` or `SWEEP_STAGE_GRANT` hit; lines 239-242 already state the block model and point to the `blocks, not suites` comment. No edit. (2) ci.yml: its only `grant` hit is line 145, about symlink privilege; lines 134-135 already state the block model. No edit. (3) CONTRIBUTING.md: lines 331-337 state the block model. The `stage_grant(jobs)` / `SWEEP_STAGE_GRANT` hits at 346-347 belong to the `budget:` sentence and describe only staged suites that run whole, the fallback for a table that is not a literal. That matches `budget_line` (tools/sweep-selftests.py:2147-2161) and the fallback comment (1661-1664). Line 340 (`a block is given its file's figure at the slots a grant would hold`) matches the code comment at 1673. No edit. (4) sweep()'s docstring already names `work_items` (1751-1752). `git show 9eeea6d5` shows that commit removed the line `costs orders the submissions (run_order)`. No edit. (5) costs_from_rows' docstring (1604-1610) already counts a block-run suite as the sum over its blocks and its replay, and a whole-run file as wall seconds times slots. No edit. (6) The shard comment (1487-1491) defers to costs_from_rows for how each kind is counted. No edit. (7) EDITED: record_costs' `about` string (tools/sweep-selftests.py:1624-1629). HEAD's wording, `the seconds of each process it ran as, times the slots that process held (one per block of a suite run block by block)`, never said the per-process figures were summed and left out the replay process. It now says: each process the file ran as, seconds times slots held, summed. A suite run block by block ran one process per block plus one replay, each on one slot, so its figure is those processes' seconds summed. A file run whole is its seconds times the slots it held. suite_ran (1726-1731) sums the blocks' and the replay's seconds with grant 1, and costs_from_rows (1611) multiplies by grant, which confirms the wording. The committed .github/sweep-costs.json still carries the old `wall seconds times the slots ... the file held` text and was not touched, as ordered; a later task re-records it. Ran: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__output_lints.py` exit 0, `3/3 files ok, 568 cases`; `ruff check tools/sweep-selftests.py` exit 0. Under executor.runsGate own-tests there was nothing of my own to run, so gates is {}. Dependants: CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and ci.yml are byte-unchanged, so every dependant listed for them is unaffected. tools/sweep-selftests.py changed only inside a string literal that is written to .github/sweep-costs.json on the next --record-costs. No name, signature or behaviour changed, so tests/test_stamp_verification.py (file_timeout, load_costs), _warning_groups.py (budget_line), PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (coverage_findings) and ci.yml are still correct. .github/sweep-costs.json gets the new text when it is re-recorded. No case pins the about text: `git grep 'process it ran as'` had one hit, the source line itself.
outcome.descriptive: The grant-model sentences the finding quotes were already rewritten at HEAD; the one stale wording left, the cost table's `about` text, now says a block-run suite's figure is its processes' seconds summed
